changelog: **Partner page legal footer and public partner terms (#3363):** the programme page, the application form and the new `/partner/terms` share one footer whose Imprint / Privacy / Terms links are the organisation's own https pages when set in the landing settings (`imprintUrl`, `privacyUrl`, `termsUrl`), else this host's own pages. `/partner/terms` shows the current partner contract read-only, signed out (404 without one). With a contract, the application form requires accepting its current version, stored on `AffiliateApplication.contractVersion` (nullable, expand-only).

en: The partner programme page links your own imprint, privacy and terms pages, and applicants can read and accept the partner terms before applying.
tr: Partner programı sayfası kendi künye, gizlilik ve şartlar sayfalarınıza bağlanıyor; başvuranlar partner sözleşmesini başvurmadan önce okuyup kabul edebiliyor.
de: Die Partnerprogramm-Seite verlinkt Ihre eigenen Seiten für Impressum, Datenschutz und AGB, und Bewerber können den Partnervertrag vor der Bewerbung lesen und akzeptieren.
